videos.title: The 20 Minute Masterpiece: Dijkstra's Algorithm
videos.author: freeCodeCamp.org
videos.description:
Explore the history behind Dijkstra’s algorithm and why it became one of the most important ideas in computer science. You’ll see how the algorithm works step by step, using weighted graphs to find the shortest path efficiently.

videos.title: TypeScript in React - Full Tutorial
videos.author: freeCodeCamp.org
videos.description:
Struggling to type React components correctly? This TypeScript React tutorial walks you through using TypeScript in real React projects, from typing useState to building reusable typed components, with hands-on challenges throughout.
